name: FileBrowser Quantum (Legacy)
description: A self-hosted web file manager forked from FileBrowser with advanced features including OIDC authentication, indexed search, office document previews, and multi-source support.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-filebrowser-quantum application
services:
  # Service name: app
  # The main FileBrowser Quantum application service
  app:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-filebrowser-quantum
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: gtstef/filebrowser:1.5.8-stable@sha256:68455d4953bad8e984e1bc5d112ed1e9c918a0a04f104c13c9ece50790308894
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      - TZ=UTC
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/home/filebrowser/data # Database and config
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/srv:/srv # Served files
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    # Networks for the big-bear-filebrowser-quantum application
    networks:
      - big-bear-filebrowser-quantum-network
# Networks definition for the big-bear-filebrowser-quantum application
networks:
  big-bear-filebrowser-quantum-network:
    driver: bridge
